title: Clo 2024.2 New Ui Tour
description:

Learn CLO the right way on CLO Academy: https://www.cloacademy.online/catalog

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2024.2 New UI Tour ## Introduction Hello everyone. Since CLO version 2024.2 is now available, I thought we'd take a little time to look at the updates to the UI just so that we can all be on the same page. ## UI Updates The toggle menus have been organized, and each section now has its own designation to describe what is coming underneath. Overall, the icons for the tools and tabs have been updated with more contrast to make things easier to see. All the tool icons are in the same place, and though visually things are changing, CLO's core tools and functions remain completely the same. ## Comparison with Version 7 Let's go back. Here is the version 7 workspace. Note the menus, the drop-down area here, and this left sidebar. In the sidebar, at this point, there are two modular libraries. The original modular library was paired with modular from the drop-down here for creating modular blocks. The new modular library combines these two processes. ## Changes in Modular Libraries In 2024, the original modular library is removed, as is the modular from the drop-down menu. Version 7.3 introduced the editor menu, which contained these options, further reducing the modes available in the drop-down menu. The menus are very similar to those in CLO versions 5 and 6, but in version 2024, the menus have been reorganized. ## Menu Adjustments Note where some things are now. The 2D menu not only includes parametric pattern here; the sewing menu has been removed, and sewing is now located at the bottom of the 2D menu. The production menu has now been added, removing the editor menu. This new menu houses colorway, bill of materials, and the grading review. ## Menu Bar Changes Connect and Closet are no longer in the menu bar in the upper right-hand side but have their own menus. The display and preferences menus have been removed, and those options are now part of the settings menu. Plugins now have their own menu, which is helpful because of the new Unreal plugin that is currently available. ## AI Chat Bot Addition We have also added our AI chat bot to the help menu to make things easier for you so that you can get assistance. The upper right-hand corner is now simpler, with only five items left in the mode drop-down, and currently, only your username is next to it. ## Introduction of New Library The biggest visual change is the introduction of our new library. Currently, this is something that is in beta, and you can try it out. When you open version 2024 for the first time, the original library is available. However, note what you have at the bottom left-hand corner: you can switch to the new library. ## Navigating the New Library When you click it, this window opens, allowing you to choose "learn more." This link will direct you to our online manual, so you can learn more about how to use this library. Once you proceed into the new library, note the icon that is now added to your upper right-hand corner. You can click this to show and hide it, or you can still use the "Y" key to show and hide the library. ## Home Area and Community Assets In the home area, you have all the CLO installed assets, just like the original library. You can change the view options as always, and see the texture of things or previews of other options if you turn on this little eye dot here. Under the command bar, under community assets, is everything available at the connect marketplace. Your personal items that you have already purchased are located here when you click this button at the bottom left. ## Account Information and Marketplace Access To the right of the library search, you have the account information, and this little icon here is a link to send you to the connect marketplace online, in your browser. The plus icon allows you to create your own libraries. This is like adding multiple folders in the original library, but now this plus sign allows you to create individual tabs for different libraries. ## Conclusion We encourage you to fully explore the new library, but if you prefer, you can go back to the original library by clicking this icon in the lower left-hand corner of the new library window. We hope you'll love our new user interface as much as we do. Thank you. ```
